what: Amazon is the largest online store in the West and owns AWS, the world's largest cloud platform. Prime, advertising, Alexa, Prime Video and Whole Foods are part of the group.
customers: Hundreds of millions of shoppers and Prime members, millions of independent sellers, and companies of every size using AWS.
money: goods Amazon buys and resells; thin margins
commissions, warehousing and delivery for other sellers
about 18% of revenue but over half of operating profit
servers, storage and AI on rent
high-margin ads on Amazon, Prime fees
moat: A logistics network that would take decades to copy, Prime membership that keeps customers loyal, and leadership in cloud computing.
risks: Fierce competition in cloud and AI, and heavy data-center spending
Thin retail margins and sensitivity to consumer slowdowns
